limitations: This script verifies that every row carries an official Hotspawn match-card link and (where applicable) a book/results link; it does not crawl every external URL. Live URL reachability is checked separately by audit/live_source_verify.py in CI and by the dated fetch receipts in EXTERNAL_LINES.md.
Probabilities on model/provisional rows are our own Elo estimates from community-maintained Leaguepedia results; they are not official league statements.
Market quotes are observations at collection time; a closed board may later answer 401/403. Those are historical receipts, not current prices.
